        10       Israel Rubin, outreach director of the Capital

        11       Chabad, Albany.

        12                  RABBI RUBIN:    This Wednesday

        13       marks a most auspicious day on the Jewish

        14       calendar, being the eve of Passover, a major

        15       family festival that marks freedom from

        16       bondage.

        17                  This year it also marks Birkat

        18       Hachama, the rare once-in-28-years Blessing of

        19       the Sun.  At this time we take special note of

        20       the planetary positioning of the recognition

        21       of the divine performance of creation, that

        22       great ball of fire in the sky that warms,

        23       lights, and energizes all of life.

        24                  It also marks, yesterday, the



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.

         1       birthday of the Lubavitcher Rebbe, whose

         2       position in Jewish history was like a sunrise

         3       after the Holocaust.

         4                  Almighty God, may we never take

         5       Your blessings for granted.  Let us always

         6       remember to express and appreciate with

         7       thankfulness.

         8                  Looking at the sun, we increase our

         9       solar awareness.  May we learn to utilize and

        10       tap its vast potential to improve our

        11       consumption of energy freedom and independence

        12       as well as global climate and well-being.

        13                  Amen.

        14                  ACTING PRESIDENT BRESLIN:    Thank

        15       you, Rabbi.
